text.en:
Codification of all insurance laws. All insurance laws embodied in the present Insurance Code and
various laws, presidential decrees and executive orders are hereby consolidated into a single Code to be
known as the Insurance Code of 1978 which shall form an integral part of this Decree.

Effectivity. The provisions of the Insurance Code of 1978 shall take effect immediately without
prejudice, however, to the effectivity dates of the various laws, decrees and executive orders which have so far
amended the provisions of the Insurance Code of the Philippines (Presidential Decree No. 612).
DONE in the City of Manila, this 11th day of June, in the year of Our Lord, nineteen hundred and
seventy-eight.
